properties.name: Today's binary reads exports taken at past releases without inventing or dropping a field
properties.statement:
A small, curated corpus of design exports taken at PAST releases is kept in the repo, and the build requires that today's binary import each one and round-trip it without inventing a field, dropping a field, or silently materialising a schema default the document did not carry.

BOUNDED ON PURPOSE: three fixtures, with a stated rule for retiring one, because the failure this guards is VERSION SKEW and not coverage. A corpus that grows with every release becomes maintenance nobody does.

WHAT IT IS FOR: every gate today runs this commit's binary against this commit's data, so the whole skew axis is untested — while the defects consuming projects actually report are old-data-meets-new-binary. The 853 edges that "gained a field on import" were an older binary injecting a stale default onto a newer document, and no gate could have caught it.

NOT IN SCOPE HERE: running an OLD binary against a NEW document, which is the other direction and needs a published release downloaded into the build.
